user.title: Mitsubishi Comfort (Kumo)
user.description: Choose how to set up the integration.

menu_options.cloud_ws: Set up using cloud websocket only (Recommended)
menu_options.import_backup: Set up using existing local unit credential backup
menu_options.cloud_fetch: Set up by fetching local unit credentials from cloud (currently broken)

import_backup.title: Import a credential backup
import_backup.description:
Units are controlled on the local network only; no cloud login is used. A login can be added later with Reconfigure.

Skipped entries: {skipped}

data_description.backup: A backup exported by this integration, a hass-kumo kumo_cache.json or a pykumo kumo.cfg.
data_description.cidrs: For example 192.168.1.0/24, at most a /22 each. Leave empty to scan the networks of Home Assistant's adapters.

confirm_addresses.title: Confirm unit addresses

cloud_login.title: Kumo Cloud login
cloud_login.description: Sign in with your Kumo Cloud account.

sites.title: Select sites
sites.description: Choose the sites to include ({site_count} found).

fetch_result.title: Some units have no local credentials
fetch_result.description:
Fetching local credentials from Kumo Cloud is currently broken. Credentials were fetched for {fetched} units. Missing: {missing}.

Retry, continue (units without credentials are controlled through Kumo Cloud), or abort and use the backup import instead.

import_pykumo.title: Import existing Kumo setup

data_description.use_account: Adds cloud fallback (auto mode). Without it, units are controlled locally only.
data_description.disable_source_entry: Running both integrations against the same units can conflict: each adapter accepts only a few connections and has a single CN105 reply buffer.

pykumo_login.title: Kumo Cloud login failed
pykumo_login.description: The stored login for {username} did not work. Enter the current password, or continue without the account.

data_description.password: Leave empty to retry the stored password.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Kumo Cloud rejected the login for {username}. Enter the current password.

reconfigure_import.title: Import a credential backup
reconfigure_import.description:
The cloud login is kept: units are then controlled locally, with Kumo Cloud as fallback (auto mode).

data_description.cidrs: For example 192.168.1.0/24, at most a /22 each. Leave empty to scan the networks of Home Assistant's adapters.

reconfigure_login.title: Kumo Cloud login
reconfigure_login.description: Add or replace the Kumo Cloud login. With a login, the auto and cloud only connection modes become available in the options.

progress.discover: Probing known addresses and scanning the network for your units. This can take a minute.
progress.fetch_credentials: Fetching unit credentials from Kumo Cloud. This can take up to a minute.

data.refresh_on_connect: Refresh state when the cloud socket connects

data_description.connection_mode: Auto uses the local network first and Kumo Cloud as fallback.
data_description.poll_interval: How often each unit is polled on the local network.
data_description.socket_idle_disconnect: Disconnect the cloud socket this long after the last unit stops needing it.
data_description.refresh_on_connect: Ask the adapters for fresh status after every cloud socket (re)connect.

data_description.target_temp_step: Step of the target temperature control. Automatic uses 1 when Home Assistant is set to Fahrenheit and 0.5 otherwise.

data.unit: Pin an address for a unit

data_description.cidrs: For example 192.168.1.0/24, at most a /22 each. Leave empty to scan the networks of Home Assistant's adapters.
data_description.unit: Pick a unit to set or clear its pinned address on the next page.
data_description.rescan: Look for all units on the subnets now.

network_pin.title: Pinned address
network_pin.description: Unit {unit}, current address {address}. A pinned address is never changed by discovery. Leave empty to clear the pin.

cn105.title: CN105 telemetry (experimental)
cn105.description: Reads extra telemetry (outdoor temperature, compressor state) over the unit's CN105 bus through the adapter. Experimental: only one local client should talk to a unit, and code 0x06 can lock the bus on some units until the adapter reboots.

remote_temp_unit.title: Remote temperature sensor
remote_temp_unit.description: Unit {unit}. Clear the sensor to remove the mapping.

data_description.interval: How often the temperature is sent to the unit when it does not change.
data_description.manage_source: Switch the unit to the remote temperature and restore its previous source when the sensor is unavailable or the mapping is removed.

view_credentials.title: Show unit secrets?
view_credentials.description: The next page shows unit passwords and crypto serials. Anyone with them can control your units on the local network. Continue only on a trusted screen.

export_kumo_cache.title: Show unit secrets?
export_kumo_cache.description: The next page shows unit passwords and crypto serials in the hass-kumo kumo_cache format. Anyone with them can control your units on the local network. Continue only on a trusted screen.

credentials_copy.title: Unit credentials
credentials_copy.description:
| Serial | Name | Address | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|
{units}

Copy the {format} JSON below and keep it somewhere safe. Submitting closes this page without changes.

import_credentials.title: Import credentials
import_credentials.description: Paste a backup, a hass-kumo kumo_cache.json or a pykumo kumo.cfg. Units are merged into the stored credentials and take effect without a reload.

import_result.title: Import finished

refresh_result.title: Refresh finished

progress.refresh_from_cloud: Fetching unit credentials from Kumo Cloud. This can take up to a minute.

cloud_auth_failed.title: Kumo Cloud login rejected
cloud_auth_failed.description: Kumo Cloud rejected the login for {title}. Units keep working locally, but cloud fallback and inventory updates are paused. Update the password to restore them.

local_auth_stale.title: Local credentials stale for {name}
local_auth_stale.description: The stored local credentials for {name} no longer work and no cloud login is configured. Import a fresh credential backup under Options > Credentials > Import.

remote_temp_source_lost.title: Remote temperature lost for {name}
remote_temp_source_lost.description: The Home Assistant temperature sensor mapped to {name} became unavailable, so the unit went back to its previous temperature source. Feeding resumes and this issue clears once the sensor reports again.
